zh: 甘肃开实体店的老板，别再被 AI 忽悠了。
en: Gansu store owners, do not get fooled by AI hype.

zh: 我是阿超，现在在兰州重新创业。
en: I am Achao, restarting my business in Lanzhou.

zh: 之前做过传统生意，也踩过不少坑。
en: I have done traditional business before, and I have stepped into plenty of traps.

zh: 所以我看 AI，从来不聊那些玄乎的概念。
en: So when I talk about AI, I do not start with abstract concepts.

zh: 我只关心：能不能解决本地小微企业的真问题？
en: I only care whether it can solve real problems for local small businesses.

zh: 餐饮店做选题，家具店写话术，工厂做跟进。
en: Restaurants need topics, furniture stores need scripts, factories need follow-ups.

zh: 很多老板一听 AI，就觉得要买系统、招技术。
en: Many owners hear AI and immediately think they need systems and engineers.

zh: 我给的建议刚好相反：第一步真不是买系统。
en: My advice is the opposite: the first step is not buying a system.

zh: 先找一个每天重复、又不想亲手做的小事。
en: Find one small repeated task you do not want to do by hand every day.

zh: 回复客户、写朋友圈、整理报价，先挑一件跑一周。
en: Replies, social copy, quotes: pick one thing and run it for a week.

zh: 这一周，只看三件事。
en: For that week, watch only three things.

zh: 省没省时间？漏没漏跟进？改一改能不能用？
en: Did it save time? Did it miss fewer follow-ups? Can small edits make it usable?

zh: 不行，也别怪 AI，大概率是资料太乱太少。
en: If not, do not blame AI first. Your materials may be too messy or too thin.

zh: 我会从兰州出发，公开记录服务本地企业的全过程。
en: Starting from Lanzhou, I will publicly record the whole local AI service process.

zh: 做成了讲透；做不成，把坑说清楚。
en: If it works, I will explain it. If it fails, I will explain the trap.

zh: 不承诺变现，不造风口神话。
en: No income promises. No manufactured hype story.

zh: 就把 AI 从概念落到实打实的业务里。
en: Bring AI down from concepts into real business work.

zh: 先别追风口，先让 AI 帮你省下半小时。
en: Do not chase hype first. Let AI save you half an hour first.

zh: 这条视频的文稿、字幕、剪辑，也都是 Codex 辅助完成的。
en: The script, subtitles, and edit of this video were also assisted by Codex.

zh: 我不是只讲落地，我自己也先这么干。
en: I am not only talking about landing AI. I am using it this way myself.

zh: 点个关注，咱们一起踩坑，一起落地。
en: Follow along. We will learn the traps and land this together.
